labels.assemble_turn_context: 装配固定规则、checkpoint 语义历史与当前 turn 内容
labels.execute_one_child_turn: 执行已准入的单个 native child turn
labels.collect_turn_facts: 计划收集本 turn 工具、子任务、operation 与验收事实；当前 ProviderToolResult.executionFact 尚未接通
labels.derive_semantic_candidate: 仅从已验证事实和原始来源按规则整理带不确定度的语义候选；原始报告本身不是语义结论
labels.save_checkpoint_boundary: 调用唯一 checkpoint 保存边界并保留未完成责任
labels.project_success_disposition: 仅当完整 durable receipt 且无未决责任时投影成功候选
labels.recovery_hold: 汇总首错、后续错误、raw、未决操作、阶段与恢复责任
labels.assess_turn_disposition: 汇合成功候选与恢复保持并返回唯一处置

design.failurePropagation: Expected failures are typed envelope values, not Operator transport failures. A failed or ineligible prerequisite gates every later side-effect stage; it returns not-executed carrying original cause and recovery responsibility. The pure success projection and pure recovery_hold projection both run and join at the unique Z node; exactly one is active by envelope state. No conditional edge is claimed.
design.routingEvidence: DAGpipe 0.1.1 installed SDK edge schema contains only from/to/arc_id and scheduler schedules every node in each topological wave. This graph is a target topology and contract, not runtime conditional-routing evidence.
design.rawRetention: Keep current-turn raw evidence until a complete durable turn receipt exists. Keep immutable journal and evidence references after raw leaves active context.
design.publicationBoundary: Publishing semantic history alone does not close the turn or grant next-turn eligibility.
design.f1HTypedFactBoundary: ProviderToolResult.executionFact attachment is the intended validated fact boundary. This is a target contract; no runtime behavior is established by this graph update.

factCollectionEdge.note: The edge remains unchanged in topology. The intended input includes the validated ProviderToolResult.executionFact attachment; its producer and Runtime consumer still require separate contract and implementation gates.

qualifiedFactBoundary.trustedIdentity: The fact identity must be derived from trusted outer execution context, not from the fact body, report prose, Provider session identity, or a bare call reference.
qualifiedFactBoundary.requiredRelationValidation: Public relation validation must bind the replay event, request, call, tool, operation, status, state, result ref and result digest to the trusted expected ToolIdentity and request before a ToolExecutionFact is admitted.
qualifiedFactBoundary.pendingFinding: H-A2 P1 remains unimplemented and has not passed independent review; this graph records the required boundary only.

design.limitedNextProof: The next limited proof covers one Responses file.search source/report receipt only. The report is the raw evidence source; it does not by itself assert semantic completeness or constitute a semantic claim.
design.rawReportBoundary: The original file.search report remains raw evidence and must retain its original status, completeness, truncation, failure, and result fields. Semantic content requires a separately validated mapper and evidence-based claim.

qualifiedReportBoundary.validator: Only validateCodeSearchReport(unknown), or an owner-approved equivalent public versioned report validator, may qualify the raw report for semantic derivation.
preconditions: The report ref, descriptor and digest equal the trusted event and qualified fact result selection.
Readback is digest checked and the original report bytes are preserved.
The descriptor scope and identity agree with the trusted request context.
qualifiedReportBoundary.outputLimit: A qualified report can yield only a bounded semantic candidate. Failed, partial, truncated and unresolved outcomes remain distinct; execution event success does not imply business search success or completeness.
qualifiedReportBoundary.implementationStatus: The public report validator, original report retention path and semantic mapper are not implemented by this graph update.

design.projectionAuthority: UI projection journal replay can demonstrate observation readback only; it is not Organ Journal authority and does not prove authoritative recovery state.
design.checkpointAndRawReleaseEligibility: Report bytes, UI projection replay and mapper output are observation or candidate evidence only; none is checkpoint, recovery, closure, next-turn, reentry or raw-release authority. A local checkpointAndClosureCommitted fact is not full five-phase readiness. The five-phase coordinator decides separately. Raw remains retained until the independently implemented complete durable turn receipt boundary is proven.
